build_only_material: woodgrain-v2.webp (32x12, sampled from generated rim; not requested at runtime)

preparation.face: trim alpha, add8px padding; resize272x320 ellipse; brightness.74 saturation.6; WebP90/alpha100
preparation.wood: crop face raw(560,55,128,48), resize32x12, same palette; used by atlas generator
preparation.water: crop raw(320,0,420,1536), resize56x192, saturation.6 brightness.9; WebP90/alpha100
preparation.buckets: project20 timber buckets into42 frames over18 degrees; embed wood as PNG in SVG and rasterize; pack7x6 WebP86/alpha100

motion: CSS28s face rotation clock; small canvas crops the matching atlas frame only when its index changes, at most30fps; no per-frame React updates
water: generated irregular painted fibers move inside fixed curved rivulet masks; original sparse paint, bucket-draining trails and waterline immersion retained
fallback: four runtime image resources and bucket canvas must succeed before replacing the original static tile
export_scope: current journal PNG uses separate SVG art and is unchanged; future full-scroll export should composite source assets and chosen atlas frame, not serialize the canvas foreignObject
